Procedures

Teach a job once. Run it again.

Describe how your team handles a kind of work. Mozart saves it as a procedure and runs it the same way every time, for any company.

Collect a past-due invoice

Saved procedure
  1. Find invoices more than 15 days late
  2. Attach the invoice and proof of delivery
  3. Send a polite reminder to the billing contact
  4. Follow up weekly, then call after three weeks

Questions

What does Mozart need to start?

Access to your inbox, your ledger and any portals you use. There is nothing to migrate, and your team keeps working where it already does.

Does anything go out without approval?

No. Every email and filing waits for your OK until you choose to let a kind of job run on its own.

What kinds of work can it run?

Any job where your company needs another company to do something: pay, sign, send a document, answer a claim. Each kind of work is a procedure you can read and change.

Who sees what Mozart learns about a company?

Only your team. What Mozart records about your customers and suppliers stays in your workspace.
